spells.targets: Yourself and/or any willing allies you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect at resolution, each with an actual regular encounter initiative slot.
spells.duration: Pending until the next numbered round boundary, then one affected round of initiative permutation; no concentration.
spells.resolution: No save. While an encounter initiative order exists, choose the eligible participants and record their desired relative order at resolution. Range, perception, willingness and allied status are checked then, with no later range tether. Outside initiative a legal cast has no scheduling effect and refunds no committed cost. This spell does not create initiative to manufacture a round. One pending Future Echo per caster; a later successful cast before execution replaces that caster’s pending schedule.
spells.effect: After the current round’s final slot and normal end-round events finish, and before the next round’s first regular start, restore any prior round’s Future Echo permutation to the baseline, retaining changes made by other exact initiative rules. Then resolve pending Future Echo schedules in application order, with stable source/mechanical order breaking genuinely simultaneous ties. For each schedule, remove selected participants who no longer possess regular encounter slots and those already claimed by an earlier Future Echo at this boundary. Gather only the remaining participants’ own baseline slot positions, sort those positions earliest to latest, and assign those participants to them in the recorded relative order. Every remaining participant is claimed by that application even if a one-person set leaves its position unchanged. Enemy, unselected and skipped participants’ slots do not move. Removed participants’ abandoned baseline slots are not redistributed. Late entrants not selected at cast resolution are not added automatically. An Incapacitated participant retaining a regular slot remains in the permutation and obeys its actual restrictions.
spells.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
spells.limitations: Each affected participant receives exactly one ordinary regular turn in the affected numbered round, with its normal movement, Action/Bonus Action permissions and regular-start Reaction refresh/recharge/death-save processing as applicable. The permutation itself creates no turn, Action, Reaction, recharge, save, pulse, fall step or recovery. Existing effects retain their previously recorded virtual markers, absolute deadlines and actual periodic clocks; a moved regular turn must not replay an already-scheduled fixed event. Effects newly created during the affected round use the actual schedule then in force. At the following boundary, the prior baseline resumes unless another exact initiative rule changes it; no midround restoration creates a duplicate or missing turn. Pending schedules can be countered, dispelled or suppressed only under an actual applicable rule. A pending schedule unavailable at its execution boundary expires without a delayed makeup. Boundary execution consumes the pending magic and records a fixed one-round turn assignment; later dispelling/suppressing that completed cast does not reverse an already-committed schedule midround. A fresh cast during the affected round can prepare the following round, after baseline restoration. Caster death alone does not erase an independent pending schedule, but a selected caster who loses their actual slot is filtered normally. Source-specific companion turns qualify only if they genuinely own regular slots, not merely for acting after an owner. If a presence is otherwise visible through the window but its native provenance is undefined/protected, that classification is Indeterminate; it is not reported as nonnative. spells.targets: One perceived corpse or substantial apparent creature remains within 60 feet and line of effect; eligibility of its deceased identity and retained memories resolves after casting costs commit.
spells.duration: Up to 1 minute or until five question exchanges are spent; no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. spells.resolution: No save or willing-soul gate. After costs commit, determine whether these are sufficient actual remains of one currently dead creature identity to support an associated retained memory echo. Bones or equivalent substantial creature remains can qualify without an intact mouth, tongue or biological flesh. An active Undead/Construct, an ordinary broken device that was never a creature, identityless ash, a stray blood trace or old remains of a currently living identity do not qualify. If no readable qualifying echo exists, obtain no answers without learning which eligibility/protection fact failed.
spells.effect: Invoke a retained memory echo associated with the addressed remains and deceased identity, not a soul, creature or resurrection. For this application you may spend up to five question exchanges. Each attempted materially unified inquiry and its answer uses one Action in initiative, or approximately six elapsed seconds outside initiative, and one question allowance; the original casting Action includes no free question. Distinct independent subquestions require their own exchanges, Actions and allowances even when spoken as one sentence. You must audibly address the remains from within 60 feet and line of effect; ordinary sound-blocking conditions apply. Each committed exchange spends its allowance even if the question is not understood or its answer is unknown/protected. The echo answers audibly from the remains, truthfully according to the deceased’s actual associated memories and beliefs before death. It uses a language the deceased knew and would reasonably use, with no automatic translation. If no mutually usable language or remembered answer supports a response, it may provide no intelligible answer, I do not know, I do not remember, or the appropriate equivalent. It cannot deliberately lie or withhold a known readable answer from hostility, but mistaken beliefs remain mistaken.

spells.limitations: Actual memories associated with the remains govern: this grants no post-death knowledge or automatic later-life memory update to an older fragment after resurrection and another death. Each application retains its own quota and deadline; asking an echo does not simultaneously question all other applications. The echo ends if the identity becomes living, the selected physical anchor no longer contains qualifying remains, the five exchanges are spent, or the spell expires/is actually ended. A temporary gap in speaking/range/sound/line of effect pauses no duration. Existing answers and ordinary remembered information persist after ending. Soul Bind or a resurrection-only blocker does not automatically block this memory echo; actual corpse, communication, memory or information protections keep their written scope.
